description_en: Queries the list of available ECS instance types for personal development environments
description_zh: 查询个人开发环境可用的 ECS 规格列表
name: ListServerIdeEcsSpecs

parameters.help_en: The DataWorks resource group identifier. You can specify the numeric ID of the resource group or the full identifier in the Serverless_res_group_{tenantId}_{resgId} format
parameters.help_zh: DataWorks 资源组标识。支持资源组数字 ID，或 Serverless_res_group_{tenantId}_{resgId} 格式的完整标识
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The accelerator type. Valid values:
CPU: uses only CPU.
GPU: uses GPU acceleration
parameters.help_zh: 加速器类型。取值 CPU 表示仅使用 CPU，GPU 表示使用 GPU 加速
parameters.name: accelerator_type

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of records to return in a single request
parameters.help_zh: 单次请求返回的最大记录数
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token used to retrieve the next page of results. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request
parameters.help_zh: 用于继续查询的分页令牌，首次调用无需传入
parameters.name: next_token
